title: Fine-Tuning Large Language Models for Domain Adaptation
source: Hu et al. (LoRA) & AI System Engineering Guide 2024
content: Fine-tuning modifies the internal parametric weights of a pre-trained language model on a curated domain-specific dataset, often via parameter-efficient techniques like Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) or full parameter tuning. Strengths: 1) Teaches specific tone, output formatting, vocabulary, and stylized communication; 2) Eliminates the latency of external search retrieval during generation; 3) Reduces prompt token overhead. Limitations: 1) Prone to catastrophic forgetting of broader reasoning abilities; 2) Static knowledge cutoff; cannot learn new information without retraining; 3) Prone to confident hallucinations on changing or unobserved facts; 4) High compute cost (training requires dedicated GPU hours like A100/H100 clusters costing $50 to $500 per fine-tuning iteration).
